summary: First full e2e pass of ESG Data Forge. Backend: 22/22 pytest cases pass (status, index 109 datasets, previews parquet/csv/json, 404/422, validation VALIDATED, anomalies 403/filters/pagination/summary splits, GHG 2022-2026 + S3-C01..C15, documents 3,539 + real PDF/DOCX/XLSX downloads, traversal 404, tree, generate 422/400/resume, export build+zip download). Resume run (seed 42, scale 0.1, docs 3000, fresh=false) skipped all batches and completed in ~1s; no fresh run triggered. Frontend: all 7 tabs and requested flows verified with Playwright; everything works. One security issue found (sibling-prefix path traversal) plus a few minor UX items.

critical.issue: Path containment check uses str(p).startswith(str(DATA.resolve())). path=../Enterprise_ESG_Synthetic_Data_x/s.txt escapes DATA_ROOT and returns 200 (reproduced with a temporary sibling dir). Use p.is_relative_to(DATA.resolve()) or compare against str(DATA)+os.sep.

minor.issue: The ZIP is written in place to the final filename. Starting a rebuild while a download of the previous ZIP is in progress truncates or corrupts that download. Write to a .tmp file and os.replace it when done. The EXPORT state is also in-memory only, so it is lost after a backend restart even though the file stays on disk.
For parquet it reads only row group 0, so an offset larger than the first row group silently returns empty rows.
by_split is in value_counts order (train, test, validation). The UI shows that order instead of train/validation/test.

Validation_Reports, which is included in the raw ZIP, exposes aggregate label info: intentionally_defective_records per dataset, anomaly_ground_truth_validation.csv with ground_truth_records per dataset, and the names of the held-out test-only anomaly subtypes. No record-level leakage was found (no ANOM- ids outside Anomaly_Ground_Truth). Consider excluding these files when include_ground_truth=false.

ui_bugs.issue: Type and format filters are independent, so many combinations give 0 results (e.g. 'Carbon accounting workbook' + pdf). The page then shows '0 synthetic business documents' with an empty grid and no 'no matches' message.
Each keystroke in gt-search fires a request with no debounce. Out-of-order responses could show stale results.

issues: document scrollWidth is 1181px, so the page scrolls horizontally (likely wide tables or charts not contained). Desktop and 1920 layouts look good.

design_issues.issue_note: folder-tree panel testid shares the 'folder-' prefix with folder-<name> items, so [data-testid^=folder-] also matches the panel itself

action_items: Fix the path containment check in /api/files/download (use Path.is_relative_to)
Write the export ZIP to a temp file and swap it atomically
Optionally exclude aggregate label info (Validation_Reports anomaly files and injected counts) from the labels-excluded ZIP
Add an empty-results message for document filters and debounce gt-search
critical_code_review_comments: server.py download(): the startswith prefix check can be bypassed (see backend critical issue)
build_zip writes in place; there is no tmp file or atomic rename
/api/status reads the whole generation.log on every 2.5s poll. Fine now, but it grows without bound over many runs.
/api/generate opens a log file handle that is never closed in the parent process (it leaks one fd per run)

success_rate.backend: 100% (22/22), plus 1 security issue found by a manual probe

seed_data_creation: None. Built Enterprise_ESG_Synthetic_Data.zip (236.8 MB, 5,562 files) in /app/data/exports. Triggered one resume run (fresh=false), which skipped all batches.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest /app/backend/tests/test_esg_forge_api.py (pytest.ini uses xdist). The export takes about 13s (not minutes). Never use fresh=true. The system clock reads Oct 2026, which explains the log timestamps. The temporary traversal-probe directory was removed.
